layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Tetris bento grids for gallery to create asymmetry. Generous spacing (p-12, p-16) across sections.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-none or subtle rounded-md (max 8px). Avoid heavy rounding to keep the luxury edge.

buttons.primary: bg-[#C2185B] text-[#FFF8E7] px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#A3144C] transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary: border border-[#C2185B] text-[#C2185B] px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#C2185B] hover:text-[#FFF8E7] transition-colors duration-300
buttons.primary_hero: bg-[#C2185B] text-[#FFF8E7] px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#A3144C] transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary_hero: border border-[#FFF8E7] text-[#FFF8E7] px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#FFF8E7] hover:text-[#2D2D2D] transition-colors duration-300

components.services_list: Cardless approach. Use flat rows with 1px border-b border-[#2D2D2D]/10. Padding inside rows. On hover, background changes to a very subtle warm white.
components.navigation: Sticky top-0 z-50 glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FFF8E7]/90 border-b border-[#2D2D2D]/10.

Header.layout: Sticky navigation, Logo on left, Links center, Book CTA on right.

Hero.layout: Full viewport height (min-h-screen) with absolute background image.
Hero.overlay: bg-black/40 overlay to ensure text contrast while letting the premium bridal shot shine.
Hero.content: Centered or Left-aligned on large screens. H1 Salon Name, H2 Tagline, two CTAs side-by-side. Text color #FFF8E7.

About_Us.layout: 2-column grid on desktop (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2), gap-16 items-center.
About_Us.content: Story of 10+ years, women-only safe space. Overlap the text box slightly over the image for an editorial feel.

Services.layout: 1-column list or 2-column masonry of categories (Bridal, Hair, Skin, Waxing & Nails).
Services.content: Minimalist service items with price ranges right-aligned. Use lucide-react icons in a soft gold circle.

Gallery.layout: Tetris-style CSS Grid. Mix of row-span-2 and col-span-2 to create a dynamic masonry/bento vibe. Gap-4.
Gallery.content: Visuals of makeup, hair, skin. Image hover effect: subtle scale-up inside an overflow-hidden container.

Contact_Location.layout: 2-column split. Left: Contact info, hours, address with large typography. Right: Google Maps iframe.
Contact_Location.background: bg-[#2D2D2D] text-[#FFF8E7] to create contrast for the footer and final CTA.

technical_instructions: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, links).
Use standard <a> tags with 'tel:' links for appointments.
Make it purely frontend standard React (.js files, NOT .tsx).
Implement smooth scrolling via CSS (scroll-behavior: smooth).
Ensure all text over the hero image passes WCAG contrast, using text-shadow if necessary.
